mapper.insert: INSERT INTO insurance_simulation (pet_id, medical_history_codes, verdict, message, assumed_annual_medical_cost_krw, assumption_source, representative_product_id, representative_product_label, is_user_adjusted) VALUES (#{petId}, #{medicalHistoryCodes}, #{verdict}, #{message}, #{assumedAnnualMedicalCostKrw}, #{assumptionSource}, #{representativeProductId}, #{representativeProductLabel}, #{isUserAdjusted})

INSERT INTO insurance_claim (pet_id, member_id, receipt_image_url, extracted_data, hospital_name, treatment_date, total_amount, claim_status) VALUES (#{petId}, #{memberId}, #{receiptImageUrl}, #{extractedData}, #{hospitalName}, #{treatmentDate}, #{totalAmount}, #{claimStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE insurance_claim SET hospital_name = #{hospitalName}, treatment_date = #{treatmentDate}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, claim_status = #{claimStatus}, claim_document_url = #{claimDocumentUrl}, extracted_data = #{extractedData}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE claim_id = #{claimId} AND claim_status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM insurance_claim WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
